svg.aria-label: wireframe schematic — the app’s own layout, drawn frame by frame: the given, then each beat. given Setup's voice-over switch, off by default; beat 1: you tick it and save → the project config records voice-over on, and Setup reads it back ticked when you return; beat 2: piper, ffmpeg or a voice model is missing → the switch is disabled, Setup names what is missing with a copyable Claude prompt and shell, and Re-check enables it once all three are present
